title: Cat and Mouse
description: Determine if the mouse can escape, the cat can catch the mouse, or if it results in a draw in a graph-based game.
pseudocode:
1. MOUSE_MOVE = 1, CAT_MOVE = 2
2. If mouse reaches 0, mouse wins (1)
3. If cat reaches mouse, cat wins (2)
4. Use memoization to track states (mouse, cat, turn)
5. If state repeats, it is a draw (0)
6. Recursively explore moves

steps.note: Initialize game state: Mouse at 1, Cat at 2, Turn is Mouse
Cat moves to node 3 to intercept mouse
Cat catches mouse at node 3, return cat wins
